working_title: EU Fulfilment from the Netherlands: A Practical Guide for US and UK Brands
audience: Operations leads and founders at US and UK ecommerce brands evaluating a European fulfilment base
secondary_keywords: Netherlands fulfilment for US brands; Netherlands fulfilment for UK brands; EU customs clearance support; PostNL fulfilment; Royal Mail direct entry; carrier selection
core_angle: Explain the operating decisions behind a Netherlands-based setup without presenting location alone as a performance guarantee.
reader_outcome: The reader can map customs requirements, the Breda warehouse, the PostNL role, the conditional Royal Mail route and carrier selection to a 3PL evaluation checklist.
outline: 1) Direct answer: what a Netherlands-based EU fulfilment setup involves; 2) Map the inbound and outbound customs questions; 3) Breda as Vareya's operating location; 4) PostNL as main carrier for shipments within the Netherlands; 5) DHL, Asendia, FedEx and Royal Mail for other routes; 6) Royal Mail direct entry for UK shipments, with timing qualified; 7) Automatic selection of an appropriate carrier by destination and parcel characteristics; 8) US/UK brand qualification checklist; 9) FAQ; 10) Scan CTA.
approved_v1_2_claims: Warehouse and address: Bagven Park 6, 4838 EH Breda, The Netherlands. | PostNL is Vareya's main carrier for shipments within the Netherlands. DHL, Asendia, FedEx and Royal Mail remain part of the carrier network for other routes. | Customs clearance support is available for shipments into and out of Europe. Contact Vareya to discuss specific requirements. | Shipments to the United Kingdom may be entered directly into the Royal Mail domestic network. Exact delivery timing depends on the agreed shipping method and is confirmed during qualification. | Vareya's shipping system can automatically select an appropriate carrier for each shipment, based on destination and parcel characteristics.
claim_guardrails: Do not claim VAT, IOSS, DDP, EORI, tax representation or import support. Do not turn Royal Mail direct entry into a delivery-time promise or a guaranteed 24-hour service. Do not claim that Breda is faster, cheaper, central or optimal without a separately approved source. Do not describe automatic carrier selection as cheapest, fastest or best. Do not use customer names, results, delivery-time figures, savings figures or universal EU/Rest of the World coverage.

working_title: Shopify Fulfilment in Europe: What to Look for in a 3PL
audience: Shopify founders and ecommerce operations leads comparing European fulfilment partners
secondary_keywords: European 3PL for Shopify; ShipHero Shopify integration; PostNL fulfilment; all-in fulfilment rates; weekend fulfilment Europe
core_angle: Turn an imprecise 3PL comparison into a five-part operating checklist: WMS integration, carrier model, commercial scope, weekend processing and service boundaries.
reader_outcome: The reader leaves with questions to ask a European 3PL and a claims-safe understanding of Vareya's approved Shopify fulfilment capabilities.
outline: 1) Direct answer: the five checks that matter; 2) WMS and Shopify integration — what to verify before onboarding; 3) Vareya uses ShipHero as its warehouse management system, fully integrated with Shopify; 4) Carrier model — PostNL in the Netherlands and the wider carrier network for other routes; 5) Read an all-in rate against the written agreement; 6) Weekend fulfilment as Saturday and Sunday order processing, not a delivery guarantee; 7) Customised SLAs and included customer support; 8) Qualification questions and comparison table; 9) FAQ; 10) Scan CTA.
approved_v1_2_claims: Vareya uses ShipHero as its warehouse management system, fully integrated with Shopify. | PostNL is Vareya's main carrier for shipments within the Netherlands. DHL, Asendia, FedEx and Royal Mail remain part of the carrier network for other routes. | Vareya's fulfilment rates are fixed and all-in per agreement — no hidden costs beyond what the agreement sets out. | Weekend fulfilment (Saturday and Sunday order processing) is available on a structural basis. | Clients can agree customised SLAs with Vareya, within boundaries confirmed during qualification. | Customer support is included at no additional charge. | Vareya is generally best suited to brands shipping 500 or more orders per month.
claim_guardrails: Do not publish a percentage of clients using Shopify. Do not claim real-time inventory, real-time tracking, zero-touch onboarding, a setup-time figure, perfect sync or support for integrations not named in v1.2. Do not imply that every surcharge, duty, tax or exceptional-handling fee is included, that every client has the same rate, or that rates cannot change under an agreement. Weekend fulfilment means Saturday and Sunday order processing; it does not guarantee same-day dispatch, delivery timing or that every order ships that weekend. Avoid fastest, cheapest, leading, number one and standalone best.
